experiment_data.hypothesis: DIF 跨模型批次分析（MH + Logistic Regression）在 N=50-80/group、污染效应量 δ≥1.0 logits 时，对 10% 污染 items 的检测功效 TPR≥0.70 且 FPR≤0.10。这是整个 pipeline 的前提假设——若 DIF 在理想合成数据上都 underpowered，则后续真实数据方案不成立。
experiment_data.notes: Conditional pass (D001): ETS C classification as primary detector. ETS C TPR=0.72-0.85 at N≥80,δ≥1.4; FPR well controlled. BH-corrected p-value based detection failed (TPR 0.04-0.07 at pass criterion). Raw power also insufficient for p-value approach. AUC discriminability good (0.91-0.96). Decision: pivot to ETS C magnitude-based detection, Phase 2 validates with real IRT parameters.
